explainer_content.short_definition: Internet-era electronic nostalgia: bedroom haze, neon synth memory, and dream-pop scale.
explainer_content.history_capsule: This road spans chillwave's washed-out home-production glow and synthwave's more cinematic retro-1980s pulse.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It made nostalgia and self-produced electronic texture central to indie and pop listening in the streaming/blog era.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The distinction is mood and memory: synthetic sounds feel intimate, faded, or cinematic rather than purely club-functional.
